from pathlib import Path
import json
home=Path.home()
root=home/'.local/state/prediction-project-executor'
campaign=home/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4'
for label,task in [('MATERIALIZE','DEV-PRED-A2Z-R4P3-MATERIALIZE-20261008-N1E135'),('QUEUE','DEV-PRED-A2Z-R4P3-ASTRA-PREBUILD-QUEUE-20261008-N1E138')]:
 p=root/(task+'.json')
 if not p.is_file():
  print(label+'=NO_STATE')
  continue
 o=json.loads(p.read_text())
 print(label+'_STATUS='+str(o.get('status','UNKNOWN')))
 print(label+'_EXIT='+str(o.get('exit_code','NONE')))
 print(label+'_ERROR='+str(o.get('error','NONE'))[:250].replace('\n',' '))
 print(label+'_FINISHED='+str(o.get('finished_at_utc','NONE')))
req=campaign/'requests/A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261008-R4P3.json'
res=campaign/'model_results/A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261008-R4P3.json'
print('ASTRA_REQUEST='+str(req.is_file()))
print('ASTRA_RESULT='+str(res.is_file()))
if req.is_file():
 o=json.loads(req.read_text())
 print('ASTRA_TASK='+str(o.get('task_id')))
 print('ASTRA_PHASE='+str(o.get('phase')))
 print('ASTRA_MODEL='+str(o.get('target_model',o.get('model_policy','UNKNOWN'))))
print('DIAGNOSTIC=PASS')
